record.body:
Implemented the latest timing/i-frame request in the installed combined build.

New hot-reloaded settings under **Movement > Combat Roll**:
- **Invulnerability Duration**: invulnerable prefix in seconds.
- **Recovery Duration**: vulnerable remainder in seconds.
- Their sum is the total roll length, so there is no contradictory third duration value.
- **Invulnerability Opacity**: player opacity during the invulnerable prefix (0 invisible, 100 fully opaque).

The roll snapshots the player's actual damageability and alpha, applies the i-frame state only for the configured prefix, and restores both exact prior values at the boundary or any interrupted exit. It measures the active P1/P2 authored phases and scales their playback so the combined visible roll matches the configured total; root motion remains owned by the authored animation.

I did **not** add a fake distance setting. The resolved Story/SDK animation task surface exposes playback rate, duration, flags, start position and rotation, but no root-translation distance scale. Playback speed changes duration without changing total authored displacement. Making distance editable with the mechanisms currently resolved would mean adding velocity/coordinate/teleport writes—the exact class of workaround that previously broke this roll. That conditional part remains unsupported unless a real root-motion distance mechanism is found.

Installed ASI: `230F15D08A8F87940C538270C83B0C18DA1F21CAE7B489087F7F2DE4C91456E7`.

Please test: short/long i-frame and recovery values, visible speed/total length, damage only after the boundary, opacity restoration, interruption restoration, all eight directions, crouched/standing, sidearm/longarm.
